captures.description: THE MAGAZINE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'Taper is an online literary magazine for small computational pieces:' with a link to the site; what it is: format ('A browser-based, biannual online literary journal and digital zine'), constraint ('strictly under 2 kilobytes (2048 bytes) in size (HTML5/code-based)'), publisher ('Published by Bad Quarto, historically coordinated with MIT's The Trope Tank'), history ('Launched in Spring 2018 with Issue #1 (a minimal labyrinth), and has grown past 16 issues (such as Taper #16: For Good Measure) managed by a volunteer editorial collective'); an offer on past themes or submitting. Six cards: taper.badquar.to (twice), Helen Shewolfe Tseng, Instagram, anjchang.com, Facebook.
